ImageDescription.value:
1928 newspaper ad for Okeh "Race Records" (African American music) - West End Blues backed by Fireworks by Louis Armstrong and His Hot Five.

Artwork depicts an African American man and women in period swimwear dancing on a beach shore, while another African American man plays guitar under a beach umbrella.
